newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Dec 10 - Santa Fe - One vessel loading wheat, no vessels in roads, 1 vessel due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 1 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, 1 vessel in roads, no vessels due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 2 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Four vessels berthed of which 3 loading wheat, 1 loading sbo. 7 Vessels in roads, 18 due at 9 terminals during the coming week. Max. draft 34 ft. 8 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep dropping for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel at Pasa berth, 24 ft. 3 in. fw., at nidera berth, 33 ft. 9 in. fw. Rosario - Six vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 2 loading sugar, 2 loading wheat. 2 Vessels in roads, 11 due during the week. Max. draft 34 ft. 8 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep dropping for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

Villa Constitucion - One vessel discharging iron ore. No vessels in roads, 2 due. Max. draft 34 ft. 8 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep dropping for the next week. Elevators berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. fw. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading steel products, 1 loading maize. 2 Vessels in roads, 5 due during the week. Max. draft 34 ft. 8 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep dropping for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Pedro - vessels berthed, 1 in roads, 1 due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Max. draft for Mitre channel at high tide is 31 ft. 6 in.

Buenos Aires - 22 Vessels in port, 35 due. Max. draft 31 ft. 6 in. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud max. recommended draft, 29 ft. fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Four vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 loading woodchips, 1 loading fish, 1 loading wheat. 2 Vessels in roads, 3 due during the week. Max. draft 40 ft. 0 in. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading fish, 2 discharging fish. 1 Loading sun pellets, 1 loading vegetable oil. No vessels in roads, 20 due. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, Dec 10 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 3 Container/general cargo loaders/dischargers, 1 steel coils/granite loader/discharger, 1 steel products loader, 1 granite loader. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 fuel discharger. Praia Mole - 3 steel plate loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel/Ubu - No vessels. 12 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 10 full containers, 2 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger, 11 sugar loaders, 5 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 juice loaders, 1 salt discharger, 1 bulk barley discharger, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 1 sulphur discharger, 1 diesel oil discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 citric pellets. 12 Vessels waiting in roads, 78 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 3 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk sulphur discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 3 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 full container, 1 soya beans discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 cellulose discharger, 1 woodchips loader. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 12 due during next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 steel products discharger, 4 container/general cargo dischargers, 1 paper discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 general cargo/steel products loader, 2 passenger vessels. Tecon - 3 Vessels. 29 vessels due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Vessels berthed. Tebar - 4 Vessels, 4 waiting in roads, 8 due during next 7 days.

CHILE, Dec 9 - Arica - No vessels in port, 5 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Two vessels operating, 4 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 2 berths available, 8 vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. No vessels in roads. Valparaiso - Four vessels berthed, working normally. 5 Berths vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement of pier 3 until april 1997. 16 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Seven vessels operating, 3 berths vacant, 11 vessels due during the week. Port busy but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - No vessels at terminal, 2 due this week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed working normally, no berths vacant, no vessels waiting in rods, 6 due during the week. Steel Pier - No vessels, 1 berth vacant. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due during the week. Lirquen - No vessels berthed, 6 berths vacant. 1 Vessel due during the week. Penco - No vessels in port. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel. Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, no vessels waiting in roads, 1 due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 4 vessels and coasters and 1 commercial vessel due during the week. No vessels in roads.

PERU, Dec 9 - Callao - Two vessels in bay, 4 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One general cargo vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar - One petroleum vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Talara - Two oil vessels in pier, no berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels in bay, 1 in pier (fishmeal), no berthing delays. Pisco, Ilo - No vessels.

VENEZUELA, Dec 9 - Puerto Cabello - One vessel anchored. 10 Vessels berthed of which 3 grain, 2 general cargo, 3 bulk cargo, 2 container vessels. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Four vessels anchored, no vessels berthed. Dec 10 - Puerto Ordaz - One vessel loading iron ore, 2 vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel due. Mile 178 - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. Matanza - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 6 operating of which 4 loading steel products, 1 discharging limestone, 1 discharging ferrosilicon. 1 Vessel due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium. Venalum - One vessel loading aluminium. Interalumina - One vessel loading alumina. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel loading crude oil.

Alcasa - One vessel discharging coke. Puerto Cabello - 12 vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 29 vessels due. Guanta - Five vessels due. La Guai - Three vessels loading/discharging generals, 12 vessels due. 3 Vessels under repair. Maracaibo - Three vessels loading/discharging generals. Puerto Miranda - Six vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. Buoy B71 - Two vessels loading coal. La Salina - One vessel loading crude oil. Bajo Grande - One vessel loading crude oil. San Francisco - Three vessels loading crude oil. Amuay - Five vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Carn - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 loading refined products. All ports are working normally.
